title: Quasar Feedback in the Ultraluminous Infrared Galaxy F11119+3257: Connecting the Accretion Disk Wind with the Large-scale Molecular Outflow
question: Does the CO(1-0) emission of the ULIRG F11119+3257 show broad wings confirming the molecular outflow, and what are its energetics compared with the OH-based estimates?

data.sensitivity: target 140 uJy per 100 km/s channel; achieved 0.28 mJy per 20 km/s channel

what.value: OH-based outflow energetics, Herschel OH 119 um profile and X-ray wind properties

evidence.quote: Local (“instantaneous”) quantities derived by T15 from the *Herschel* OH 119 $\mu$m presented in V13.

external_data.citation: Tombesi et al. 2015 (T15); Veilleux et al. 2013 (V13)

evidence.quote: $L_{\rm AGN}$ = 1.5 $\times$ 10$^{46}$ ergs s$^{-1}$, derived from the infrared 15-to-30 $\mu$m color and the prescription of Veilleux et al. (2009)
adopt a ULIRG-like $\alpha_{\rm CO}$ of 0.8 $M_\odot$ (K km s$^{-1}$ pc$^2$)$^{-1}$ as done by Cicone et al. (2014)

external_data.citation: Cicone et al. 2014; Bolatto et al. 2013

recipe.method: Continuum subtraction in uv plane, Briggs imaging at 20 km/s
Simultaneous narrow plus broad Gaussian fit to 3 and 5 arcsec aperture spectra

recipe.goal: Remove rotating disk and isolate high-velocity gas
recipe.method: Fit 2D Gaussian per channel; build smooth source model with linearly changing position, Gaussian intensity, constant size and orientation; subtract to obtain residual cube

recipe.goal: Measure size and flux of the outflow
recipe.method: Gaussian fit to high-velocity map and aperture photometry growth curve
Mass from integrated flux with alpha_CO; Mdot = M V/R, Pdot = Mdot V, Edot = 1/2 Mdot V^2

answer_key.quantity: Broad Gaussian integrated flux, 3 arcsec aperture

evidence.quote: 4$\ensuremath{''}$8$^{+1.5}_{-2.7}$ = 15$^{+5}_{-8}$ kpc, is our best estimate of the maximum extent of the CO outflow.
This results in an outflowing molecular gas mass of $\sim$ (0.6 $-$ 1.4) $\times$ 10$^9$ $M_\odot$
a dynamical mass of $\sim$5 $\times$ 10$^9$ $M_\odot$ within $\sim$1 kpc from the center is derived

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channels used for the continuum fit
Number of clean iterations, threshold, cell and image size
Exact velocity range used for the two-Gaussian fits and the bootstrap setup
How the rotation model velocity-gradient fit was parametrized in detail
How R_out and V_out nominal values map to the quoted mass ranges (aperture flux choices)
missing_for_reproduction: Aperture centers and exact flux ranges behind mass ranges
score_reason: Single dataset with reasonably clear steps, but several imaging and fitting details are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Single-project data, mainly numeric results (fluxes, rates), recipe mostly reproducible.
